text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: Bonferroni and Holm: two ways to keep FWER ≤ 0.05

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Five planned comparisons, p-values sorted from smallest to largest

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #222222

g.text: Bonferroni: compare every p with α/m. Holm: compare the k-th smallest with α/(m − k + 1) and stop at the first failure.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: Both control FWER for any dependence between tests. Holm always rejects at least as many as Bonferroni.
